<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <script>window.livecodes = window.livecodes || {};</script>
    <title>☬SHΞN™ V2Ray Sub Builder</title>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;700;800;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }
        :root {
            --bg: #0b0c10;
            --card: #15171e;
            --panel: rgba(21, 23, 30, 0.70);
            --border: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.18);
            --text: #e8e8e8;
            --muted: #8b8e98;
            --accent: #c9a227;
            --accent2: #d4af37;
            --accent-glow: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.35);
            --good: #4ade80;
            --warn: #fbbf24;
            --bad: #f87171;
            --mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
            --sans: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
            --shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            --radius: 24px;
        }
        html,
        body {
            height: 100%;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        body {
            margin: 0;
            font-family: var(--sans);
            color: var(--text);
            background: var(--bg) radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, #1a1b24 0%, var(--bg) 70%) no-repeat;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Stars */
        .stars:before,
        .stars:after {
            content: "";
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20% 10%, rgba(201, 162, 39, .20) 40%, transparent 41%),
                radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 70% 30%, rgba(201, 162, 39, .12) 40%, transparent 41%),
                radial-gradient(1px 1px at 10% 70%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .08) 40%, transparent 41%),
                radial-gradient(2.5px 2.5px at 85% 80%, rgba(201, 162, 39, .18) 40%, transparent 41%),
                radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 40% 85%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .08) 40%, transparent 41%);
            opacity: 0.5;
            filter: blur(0.5px);
            animation: drift 50s linear infinite;
        }
        .stars:after {
            opacity: 0.35;
            animation-duration: 80s;
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }
        @keyframes drift {
            from {
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(20px);
            }
        }

        header {
            padding: 28px 16px 10px;
            text-align: center;
            animation: fadeInDown 0.8s ease;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        h1 {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 58px);
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, var(--accent) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            color: transparent;
            text-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.15);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-family: var(--sans);
        }
        .sub {
            margin-top: 8px;
            color: var(--accent2);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 13px;
            letter-spacing: 0.35em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            opacity: 0.85;
            text-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .wrap {
            max-width: 1240px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 16px 16px 40px;
            display: grid;
            gap: 24px;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            animation: fadeIn 1s ease;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        @media (min-width: 980px) {
            .wrap {
                grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
                gap: 32px;
            }
        }

        /* Panels */
        .panel {
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }
        .panel:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
        }

        .panel .hd {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 18px 24px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        }
        .hd .title {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 15px;
            letter-spacing: 0.02em;
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .hd .title .label {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 14px;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            color: #d0d0d0;
        }
        .hd .title .label em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent2);
            font-weight: 800;
        }
        .pill {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text);
            background: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.18);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.25);
            padding: 4px 14px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }
        .dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--accent-glow);
            animation: pulse 2s infinite;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        @keyframes pulse {
            0% {
                transform: scale(0.95);
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-glow);
            }
            70% {
                transform: scale(1);
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(201, 162, 39, 0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(0.95);
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(201, 162, 39, 0);
            }
        }

        .bd {
            padding: 22px 24px;
        }

        /* Inputs */
        textarea,
        input[type="text"],
        input[type="number"] {
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 18px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50);
            color: var(--text);
            padding: 16px 18px;
            outline: none;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }
        textarea {
            min-height: 130px;
            resize: vertical;
            padding-bottom: 54px;
            padding-right: 60px;
            padding-left: 16px;
        }
        textarea::placeholder,
        input::placeholder {
            color: var(--text);
            opacity: 0.55;
            font-family: var(--sans);
            font-weight: 400;
        }
        textarea:focus,
        input:focus {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.12), inset 0 0 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        }

        .row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .row>* {
            flex: 1 1 170px;
        }
        .small {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--muted);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
            direction: ltr;
            text-align: left;
        }
        .small.rtl {
            direction: rtl;
            text-align: right;
        }

        /* Tabs */
        .tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 14px 24px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        }
        .tab {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 10px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            color: var(--muted);
            font-weight: 800;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            user-select: none;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-family: var(--sans);
        }
        .tab.active {
            background: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.10);
            color: var(--accent);
            border-color: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.35);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        }
        .tab:hover:not(.active) {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .tab .i {
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 11px;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        /* Checks */
        .grid2 {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            gap: 18px;
        }
        @media (min-width: 520px) {
            .grid2 {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }
        }
        .checks {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
        }
        .check {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .check:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.08);
        }
        .check input {
            width: 17px;
            height: 17px;
            accent-color: var(--accent);
            cursor: pointer;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .check span {
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 12px;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            color: var(--text);
        }

        /* Primary Button */
        .btn {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 18px 16px;
            border-radius: 18px;
            border: 1px solid var(--accent);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 15px;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: #000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent2) 0%, var(--accent) 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.20);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 12px;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            font-family: var(--sans);
        }
        .btn::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: -100%;
            width: 50%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30), transparent);
            transition: all 0.5s ease;
        }
        .btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.30);
            filter: brightness(1.08);
        }
        .btn:hover:not(:disabled)::after {
            left: 100%;
        }
        .btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
            box-shadow: none;
            filter: grayscale(1);
            border-color: transparent;
        }
        .btn .spin {
            animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite;
        }
        @keyframes spin {
            from {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        /* Terminal */
        .terminal {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 440px;
        }
        .term-hd {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 14px 22px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }
        .lights {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .light {
            width: 11px;
            height: 11px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        .light.r {
            background: var(--bad);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--bad);
        }
        .light.y {
            background: var(--warn);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--warn);
        }
        .light.g {
            background: var(--good);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--good);
        }
        .term-hd .status-label {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 11px;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--muted);
            margin-left: 10px;
        }

        /* Progress bar */
        .progress-wrap {
            padding: 0 22px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.20);
            height: 4px;
            position: relative;
            display: none;
            transition: height 0.2s;
        }
        .progress-wrap.active {
            display: block;
            height: 4px;
        }
        .progress-bar {
            height: 100%;
            width: 0%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent));
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
        }
        .progress-text {
            position: absolute;
            right: 22px;
            top: -14px;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-family: var(--mono);
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 700;
            opacity: 0.9;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        /* Log container */
        .term {
            padding: 18px 22px;
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.7;
            overflow-y: auto;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            flex: 1;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70);
            min-height: 200px;
            max-height: 380px;
        }
        .term::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 5px;
        }
        .term::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .term::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .line {
            padding: 6px 0 6px 4px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
            animation: slideIn 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 10px;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(12px);
        }
        .line .ts {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 11px;
            opacity: 0.6;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-weight: 400;
            letter-spacing: 0.02em;
            min-width: 62px;
        }
        .line-icon {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-weight: 700;
            opacity: 0.85;
            width: 20px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .line .msg {
            word-break: break-word;
        }
        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateX(12px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
        }

        .ok {
            color: var(--good);
        }
        .ok .line-icon {
            color: var(--good);
        }
        .er {
            color: var(--bad);
        }
        .er .line-icon {
            color: var(--bad);
        }
        .in {
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .in .line-icon {
            color: #7a8a9e;
        }
        .wa {
            color: var(--warn);
        }
        .wa .line-icon {
            color: var(--warn);
        }
        .ac {
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .ac .line-icon {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* Spinner line */
        .line.spinner .line-icon {
            animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite;
            display: inline-block;
        }
        @keyframes spin {
            from {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        /* Bottom actions */
        .bd-footer {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            padding: 18px 24px;
        }
        .count {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 6px 0 14px;
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 64px;
            letter-spacing: -0.04em;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-shadow: 0 10px 30px var(--accent-glow);
            font-family: var(--mono);
            line-height: 1;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .count.pulse {
            animation: countPulse 0.6s ease;
        }
        @keyframes countPulse {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            50% {
                transform: scale(1.10);
                color: var(--accent2);
            }
        }

        .actions {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 14px;
        }
        .btn2 {
            padding: 14px 12px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            color: var(--text);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-family: var(--sans);
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
            letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        }
        .btn2:hover:not(:disabled) {
            color: var(--accent);
            border-color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.10);
            box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.10);
        }
        .btn2:disabled {
            opacity: 0.35;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        /* Attach button - moved to right */
        .ta-wrap {
            position: relative;
        }
        .attach-btn {
            position: absolute;
            right: 14px;
            bottom: 14px;
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
            color: var(--text);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            left: auto;
        }
        .attach-btn:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.12);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }
        .attach-btn svg {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            opacity: 1;
        }
        .file-hidden {
            display: none !important;
        }

        footer {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 30px 16px 40px;
            color: var(--muted);
            animation: fadeIn 1s ease;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .footer-link {
            color: var(--accent);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            font-size: 14px;
            padding: 10px 28px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--sans);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }
        .footer-link:hover {
            color: #000;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 28px var(--accent-glow);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .kbd {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 11px;
            padding: 2px 10px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50);
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        @keyframes fadeInDown {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(-20px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }
        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        /* Responsive tweaks */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .hd .title .label {
                font-size: 12px;
            }
            .bd {
                padding: 16px;
            }
            .tabs {
                padding: 10px 14px;
                gap: 6px;
            }
            .tab {
                font-size: 11px;
                padding: 10px 6px;
            }
            .checks {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                gap: 6px;
            }
            .check {
                padding: 8px 10px;
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            .check span {
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            .term {
                font-size: 12px;
                padding: 12px 14px;
                min-height: 160px;
                max-height: 280px;
            }
            .line .ts {
                min-width: 44px;
                font-size: 10px;
            }
            .count {
                font-size: 44px;
            }
            .actions {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                gap: 10px;
            }
            .btn2 {
                font-size: 12px;
                padding: 12px 8px;
            }
            .attach-btn {
                right: 10px;
                bottom: 10px;
                width: 38px;
                height: 38px;
            }
            .attach-btn svg {
                width: 18px;
                height: 18px;
            }
            textarea {
                padding-right: 50px;
                padding-left: 12px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <div class="stars"></div>

    <header>
        <h1>☬SHΞN™ SPLITTΞR</h1>
        <div class="sub">V2Ray splitting toolkit</div>
    </header>

    <main class="wrap">
        <!-- LEFT PANEL -->
        <section class="panel">
            <div class="hd">
                <div class="title">
                    <span class="dot"></span>
                    <span class="label"><em>Sources</em> <span style="opacity:0.6;font-weight:400;">(Link / Text / File)</span></span>
                </div>
                <span class="pill">Smart Input</span>
            </div>
            <div class="bd">
                <div class="ta-wrap">
                    <textarea id="mainInput" dir="auto" placeholder="If empty, default sources will be loaded on process.
You can paste:
1) Subscription links
2) Raw config text
3) Attach a file"></textarea>
                    <button class="attach-btn" type="button" title="Attach file" onclick="document.getElementById('fileInput').click()">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                            <defs>
                                <linearGradient id="goldGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                                    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d4af37"/>
                                    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c9a227"/>
                                </linearGradient>
                            </defs>

    <script>
        // ─── CONSTANTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        const PROTOCOLS = ["vless", "vmess", "hysteria2", "hy2", "trojan", "ss", "hysteria",
            "socks", "socks5", "http", "https"

            "spx", "flow"
        ];

        const TRANSPORT_BONUS = new Map([
            ["ws", 10],
            ["grpc", 9],
            ["tcp", 6],
            ["h2", 6],
            ["http", 5],
            ["xhttp", 8],
            ["splithttp", 8],
            ["httpupgrade", 7],
            ["quic", 4],
            ["kcp", 3]
        ]);
        const SECURITY_BONUS = new Map([
            ["reality", 12],
            ["tls", 8],
            ["xtls", 8],
            ["none", 0],
            ["", 0]
        ]);

        const GREEK = ["Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta", "Epsilon", "Zeta", "Eta", "Theta", "Iota",

        function getSourceName(i) {
            if (i < GREEK.length) return GREEK[i];

        function renderChecks(containerId, items, name) {
            const el = document.getElementById(containerId);

        // ─── MODE SWITCH ──────────────────────────────────────────
        function switchMode(m) {
            if (isProcessing) return;
            mode = m;
            document.getElementById("tabSmart").classList.toggle("active", m === "smart");
            document.getElementById("tabManual").classList.toggle("active", m === "manual");
            document.getElementById("smartBox").style.display = (m === "smart") ? "block" : "none";
            document.getElementById("manualBox").style.display = (m === "manual") ? "block" : "none";
            log(`Switched to ${m.toUpperCase()} mode`, "in");
        }

        // ─── LOGGING (with timestamp) ─────────────────────────────
        function log(msg, cls = "in", noAnim = false) {
            const box = document.getElementById("log");
            const div = document.createElement("div");
            const ts = new Date();
            const tStr = ts.toLocaleTimeString("en-GB", { hour12: false });
            div.className = "line " + cls;
            if (noAnim) div.style.animation = "none";
            let icon = "⚡";
            if (cls === "ok") icon = "✔";
            if (cls === "er") icon = "✖";
            if (cls === "wa") icon = "⚠";
            if (cls === "in") icon = "ℹ";
            if (cls === "ac") icon = "◆";
            div.innerHTML =
                `<span class="ts">${tStr}</span><span class="line-icon">${icon}</span><span class="msg">${msg}</span>`;
            box.appendChild(div);
            box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
        }

        function clearLog() {
            document.getElementById("log").innerHTML = "";

        function setStatus(label, color = "#c9a227") {

        // ─── PROGRESS INDICATOR ──────────────────────────────────
        function updateProgress(percent, label) {
            const wrap = document.getElementById('progressWrap');
            const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');

            if (percent < 0 || percent > 100) percent = 0;
            if (percent === 0) {
                wrap.classList.remove('active');
                wrap.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                wrap.style.display = 'block';
                wrap.classList.add('active');
                bar.style.width = percent + '%';
                text.textContent = Math.round(percent) + '%';

                    setStatus(label, '#fbbf24');

        }

            isProcessing = b;

            document.getElementById("runText").textContent = b ? "Processing..." : "Process & Rank";
            if (!b) {
                setStatus("IDLE", "#8b8e98");

        // ─── FILE ATTACH ──────────────────────────────────────────
        function onFile(e) {
            const f = e.target.files?.[0];

        // ─── FETCH WITH FALLBACK ──────────────────────────────────
        function getProxies() {
            return ["https://corsproxy.io/?", "https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url="];

        async function fetchWithFallback(url) {
            try {
                const controller = new AbortController();
                const t = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);
                const res = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store" });
                clearTimeout(t);
                if (res.ok) return await res.text();
            } catch (_) { /* fall through */ }

            const proxies = getProxies();
            for (const p of proxies) {
                try {
                    const target = p + encodeURIComponent(url);
                    const controller = new AbortController();
                    const t = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 7000);
                    const res = await fetch(target, { signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store" });
                    clearTimeout(t);
                    if (res.ok) return await res.text();
                } catch (_) { /* continue */ }
            }
            throw new Error("Fetch failed for " + url);
        }

        // ─── EXTRACTION HELPERS ──────────────────────────────────
        function looksBase64Whole(text) {
            const s = (text || "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, "");
            if (s.length < 80) return false;
            return /^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+$/.test(s);
        }

        function safeAtobUnicode(b64) {
            const padded = b64 + "=".repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4);
            const bin = atob(padded.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/"));
            try {
                return decodeURIComponent(Array.prototype.map.call(bin, c =>
                    "%" + ("00" + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2)).join(""));
            } catch (_) { return bin; }
        }

        function extractConfigs(text) {
            let full = text || "";
            if (looksBase64Whole(full)) {
                try {
                    const decoded = safeAtobUnicode(full.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ""));
                    if (decoded.includes("://")) { full += "\n" + decoded;
                        log("Base64 decoded successfully.", "ok"); }
                } catch (_) {}
            }
            const lines = full.split(/\r?\n/);
            for (const line of lines) {
                const s = (line || "").trim();
                if (!s) continue;
                if (/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+$/.test(s) && s.length > 40) {
                    try {
                        const decoded = safeAtobUnicode(s);
                        if (decoded.includes("://")) full += "\n" + decoded;
                    } catch (_) {}
                }
            }
            const re = /(vmess|vless|hysteria2|hy2|trojan|ss|hysteria|socks|socks5|http|https):\/\/[^\s"'<>]+/gim;
            const m = full.match(re) || [];
            return Array.from(new Set(m.map(x => x.trim())));
        }

        // ─── NORMALIZATION ────────────────────────────────────────
        function normalizeConfig(cfg, remark) {
            const low = cfg.toLowerCase();
            if (low.startsWith("vmess://")) return remarkVmess(cfg, remark);
            if (low.startsWith("vless://") || low.startsWith("hysteria2://") || low.startsWith("hy2://") ||
                low.startsWith("trojan://") || low.startsWith("ss://") || low.startsWith("hysteria://") ||
                low.startsWith("socks://") || low.startsWith("socks5://") || low.startsWith("http://") ||
                low.startsWith("https://")) {
                return remarkUrlFragment(cfg, remark);
            }
            return null;
        }

        function remarkUrlFragment(cfg, remark) {
            try {
                const i = cfg.indexOf("#");
                const base = (i >= 0) ? cfg.slice(0, i) : cfg;
                return base + "#" + encodeURIComponent(remark);
            } catch (_) { return cfg; }
        }

        function remarkVmess(cfg, remark) {
            try {
                const payload = cfg.slice("vmess://".length);
                const jsonStr = safeAtobUnicode(payload.trim());
                const obj = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
                obj.ps = remark;
                const out = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(obj))))
                    .replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
                return "vmess://" + out;
            } catch (_) { return null; }
        }

        function portBonus(port) {
            if (!port || port <= 0) return -50;
            return GOOD_PORTS.has(port) ? 5 : 0;
        }

        function qdict(qs) {
            const p = new URLSearchParams(qs || "");
            const out = {};
            for (const [k, v] of p.entries()) { if (!(k in out)) out[k] = v; }
            return out;
        }

        // ─── KEY + SCORE ──────────────────────────────────────────
        function vmessKeyScore(cfg) {
            try {
                const payload = cfg.slice("vmess://".length);
                const jsonStr = safeAtobUnicode(payload.trim());
                const d = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
                const add = String(d.add || "").trim().toLowerCase();
                const port = parseInt(String(d.port || "0").trim(), 10) || 0;
                const net = String(d.net || "").trim().toLowerCase() || "tcp";
                const tls = String(d.tls || "").trim().toLowerCase();
                const key = `vmess|${add}|${port}|${net}`;
                let score = 20 + (TRANSPORT_BONUS.get(net) || 4) + (tls === "tls" ? 10 : 2) + portBonus(port);
                return { key, score, cfg };
            } catch (_) { return null; }
        }

        function vlessKeyScore(cfg) {
            try {
                const scheme = cfg.split("://")[0].toLowerCase();
                const fake = "http://" + cfg.slice((scheme + "://").length);
                const u = new URL(fake);
                const host = (u.hostname || "").trim().toLowerCase();
                const port = parseInt(u.port || "0", 10) || 0;
                const q = qdict(u.search);
                const t = (q.type || "tcp").toLowerCase();
                const security = (q.security || "").toLowerCase();
                const key = `${scheme}|${host}|${port}|${t}`;
                let score = 25 + (TRANSPORT_BONUS.get(t) || 4) + (SECURITY_BONUS.get(security) || 2) + portBonus(port);
                return { key, score, cfg };
            } catch (_) { return null; }
        }

        function genericKeyScore(cfg) {
            try {
                const scheme = cfg.split("://")[0].toLowerCase();
                const actualUrl = (scheme === "http" || scheme === "https") ? cfg : "http://" + cfg.slice((scheme + "://")
                .length);
                const u = new URL(actualUrl);
                const host = (u.hostname || "").trim().toLowerCase();
                const port = parseInt(u.port || (scheme === "https" ? "443" : "80"), 10) || 0;
                const q = qdict(u.search);
                const t = ((q.type || q.mode || "") + "").toLowerCase() || "tcp";
                const key = `${scheme}|${host}|${port}`;
                let score = 15 + (TRANSPORT_BONUS.get(t) || 3) + portBonus(port);
                return { key, score, cfg };
            } catch (_) { return { key: "raw|" + cfg, score: 1, cfg }; }
        }

        function makeKeyScore(cfg) {
            const low = cfg.toLowerCase();
            if (low.startsWith("vmess://")) return vmessKeyScore(cfg);
            if (low.startsWith("vless://")) return vlessKeyScore(cfg);
            return genericKeyScore(cfg);
        }

        // ─── PARSE META ──────────────────────────────────────────
        function parseMetaQuick(cfg) {
            const low = cfg.toLowerCase();
            let type = low.split("://")[0],
                net = "tcp",
                port = null;
            try {
                if (low.startsWith("vmess://")) {
                    const d = JSON.parse(safeAtobUnicode(cfg.slice("vmess://".length).trim()));
                    net = String(d.net || "tcp").toLowerCase();
                    port = parseInt(String(d.port || "0"), 10) || null;
                } else {
                    const actualUrl = (low.startsWith("http://") || low.startsWith("https://")) ? cfg : "http://" + cfg.slice((
                        type + "://").length);
                    const u = new URL(actualUrl);
                    port = parseInt(u.port || (low.startsWith("https://") ? "443" : "80"), 10) || null;
                    const q = qdict(u.search);
                    net = String(q.type || q.mode || (q.serviceName ? "grpc" : "tcp")).toLowerCase();
                }
                return { valid: true, type, net, port };
            } catch (_) { return { valid: false, type, net, port }; }
        }

        // ─── SAMPLE ANALYSIS ──────────────────────────────────────
        function analyzeSamples(text) {
            const hint = document.getElementById("smartHint");
            if (!text || !text.trim()) { sampleStats = null;
                hint.style.display = "none"; return; }
            const cfgs = extractConfigs(text);
            if (!cfgs.length) { sampleStats = null;
                hint.style.display = "none"; return; }
            const protos = new Set(),
                nets = new Set(),
                ports = new Set();
            for (const c of cfgs) {
                const m = parseMetaQuick(c);
                if (!m.valid) continue;
                protos.add(m.type);
                nets.add(m.net);
                if (m.port) ports.add(String(m.port));
            }
            sampleStats = { protos: [...protos], nets: [...nets], ports: [...ports] };
            document.getElementById("sProto").textContent = sampleStats.protos.join(",") || "*";
            document.getElementById("sNet").textContent = sampleStats.nets.join(",") || "*";
            document.getElementById("sPort").textContent = sampleStats.ports.slice(0, 3).join(",") + (sampleStats.ports
                .length > 3 ? "…" : "");
            hint.style.display = "block";
            log("Sample pattern detected.", "ok");
        }

        function getRules() {
            if (mode === "smart") {
                if (sampleStats && (sampleStats.protos.length || sampleStats.nets.length || sampleStats.ports.length)) {
                    return { protos: new Set(sampleStats.protos), nets: new Set(sampleStats.nets), ports: new Set(
                            sampleStats.ports) };

                return { protos: null, nets: null, ports: null };
            }
            const protos = new Set(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="proto"]:checked')).map(x => x.value
            .toLowerCase()));
            const nets = new Set(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="net"]:checked')).map(x => x.value
            .toLowerCase()));
            const portsArr = (document.getElementById("portsManual").value || "").split(",").map(x => x.trim()).filter(
            Boolean);
            return { protos: protos.size ? protos : null, nets: nets.size ? nets : null, ports: portsArr.length ? new Set(
                    portsArr) : null };
        }

        function passesRules(meta, rules) {
            if (rules.protos && !rules.protos.has(meta.type)) return false;
            if (rules.nets && meta.net && !rules.nets.has(meta.net)) return false;
            if (rules.ports && meta.port && !rules.ports.has(String(meta.port))) return false;
            return true;
        }

                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ALIILAPRO/v2rayNG-Config/main/sub.txt\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pawdroid/Free-servers/main/sub\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mfuu/v2ray/master/v2ray.txt\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ermaozi/get_subscribe/main/subscribe/v2ray.txt\n" +
                        "https://mifa.world/ss\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mosifree/-FREE2CONFIG/refs/heads/main/FRAGMENT\n" +
                        "https://empty-mouse-fbb7.alizareh4024.workers.dev/sync?sub=%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B1%F0%9F%A6%8E\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pytimusprime/FreeV2ray/refs/heads/main/all_servers.txt\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThomasJasperthecat/sub/main/sublist1.txt\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/masir-sefid/Sub/main/@Masir_Sefid.txt\n" +
                        "https://sub.whitedns.one/sub/mihomo.yaml\n" +
                        "http://main.pythash.tr/FRkh99yBGCllN/01736620-2086-4c0b-a86e-52ebfe64dd12/#pythash\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/masir-sefid/Sub/main/Telegram-Channel-@Masir_Sefid.txt\n" +
                        "https://c6et83fe1u99lr8j5w4s9iwik9565bqx.pages.dev/sub/fragment/g4lWgI*%40zehfoOEK?app=xray#%F0%9F%92%A6%20BPB%20Fragment\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AmyraxVPN-Main/AmyraxVPN/refs/heads/main/AmyraxVPN.txt\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arshiacomplus/v2rayExtractor/refs/heads/main/mix/sub.html\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MahsaNetConfigTopic/config/refs/heads/main/xray_final.txt\n" +
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/barry-far/V2ray-config/main/All_Configs_base64_Sub.txt\n" +
                        "https://v2.alicivil.workers.dev";
                }

                log("Syncing inputs…", "in");
                updateProgress(10, "Fetching sources");
                const tokens = raw.split(/[\s\r\n]+/).map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                const urls = tokens.filter(x => /^https?:\/\/\S+$/i.test(x));
                let combined = raw;

                if (urls.length) {
                    log(`Fetching ${urls.length} subscription sources…`, "wa");
                    const total = urls.length;
                    let fetched = 0;
                    const results = await Promise.all(urls.map(async (u, idx) => {
                        const sName = getSourceName(idx);
                        log(`→ ${sName} …`, "in");
                        try {
                            const t = await fetchWithFallback(u);
                            log(`✓ ${sName} received (${(t.length/1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`, "ok");
                            return t;
                        } catch (_) {
                            log(`✗ ${sName} unreachable`, "er");
                            return "";
                        } finally {
                            fetched++;
                            const pct = 10 + Math.min(50, Math.floor((fetched / total) * 40));
                            updateProgress(pct, `Fetching ${fetched}/${total}`);
                        }
                    }));
                    results.forEach(t => { if (t) combined += "\n" + t; });
                }

                updateProgress(55, "Extracting configs");
                const rawCfgs = extractConfigs(combined);
                log(`Extracted ${rawCfgs.length} raw configs.`, "in");

                // Filter out subscription-links that were accidentally extracted as http/https proxies
                const isSubLink = new Set(urls.map(u => {
                    try { return new URL(u).href.toLowerCase(); } catch (_) { return u.toLowerCase(); }
                }));

                const filteredCfgs = rawCfgs.filter(c => {
                    const low = c.toLowerCase();
                    if (low.startsWith("http://") || low.startsWith("https://")) {
                        try {
                            const u = new URL(c);
                            const normalized = u.href.toLowerCase();
                            if (isSubLink.has(normalized) || isSubLink.has(normalized.replace(/\/$/, "")))
                                return false;
                            if (isSubLinkCandidate(c)) return false;
                            if (!u.port) return false;
                            if (u.pathname === "/" || u.pathname === "" || u.pathname === "//") return false;
                        } catch (_) { return false; }
                    }
                    return true;
                });

                if (!filteredCfgs.length) throw new Error("No valid configs found.");

                log(`Valid configs after filter: ${filteredCfgs.length}`, "in");
                updateProgress(70, "Deduplicating");
                log("Deduplicating & ranking…", "wa");

                const rules = getRules();
                const bestByKey = new Map();

                for (const c of filteredCfgs) {
                    const norm = normalizeConfig(c, remark);
                    if (!norm) continue;
                    const meta = parseMetaQuick(norm);
                    if (!meta.valid || !passesRules(meta, rules)) continue;
                    const ks = makeKeyScore(norm);
                    if (!ks) continue;
                    const prev = bestByKey.get(ks.key);
                    if (!prev || ks.score > prev.score) {
                        bestByKey.set(ks.key, ks);
                    }
                }

                log(`Dedup: ${bestByKey.size} unique configs.`, "ok");
                updateProgress(85, "Sorting");

                const scored = Array.from(bestByKey.values())
                    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
                    .slice(0, maxOutput);

                processed = scored.map(x => x.cfg);
                log(`Final: ${processed.length} configs ready.`, "ok");
                updateProgress(100, "Done");
                setTimeout(() => updateProgress(0), 800);
                updateOutput(processed.length);

            } catch (e) {
                log(e?.message || "Unknown error", "er");
                updateOutput(0);
                updateProgress(0);
            } finally {
                setBusy(false);
            }
        }

        // ─── UI UPDATES ──────────────────────────────────────────
        function updateOutput(n) {
            const el = document.getElementById("finalCount");
            el.textContent = String(n);
            el.classList.remove("pulse");
            void el.offsetWidth;
            if (n > 0) el.classList.add("pulse");
            const ok = n > 0;
            document.getElementById("downloadBtn").disabled = !ok;
            document.getElementById("copyBtn").disabled = !ok;
        }

        function downloadTxt() {
            if (!processed.length) return;
            const blob = new Blob([processed.join("\n") + "\n"], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement("a");
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `SHEN_Sub_${Date.now()}.txt`;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            a.remove();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            log("File downloaded.", "ok");
        }

        async function copyTxt() {
            if (!processed.length) return;
            const text = processed.join("\n");
            try {
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
                log("Output copied to clipboard!", "ok");
            } catch (_) {
                const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
                ta.value = text;
                document.body.appendChild(ta);
                ta.select();
                document.execCommand("copy");
                ta.remove();
                log("Output copied (fallback).", "ok");
            }
        }
    </script>
